name: cross-body-arm-swings
instructions:
1. In an upright position, reach forward with your arms.
2. Swing your arms open and allow your shoulder blades to retract while getting a stretch in your pecs.
3. When the arms are fully stretched, return to the starting position by flexing the pecs and allow the arms to cross.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
